findings.passage: There is tremendous potential to advance commonsense laws at the federal level such as background checks, licensing requirements and firearm restrictions— including a renewal of the assault weapons ban.
findings.note: Press release from his office, quoting him; he asked two national state-lawmaker groups to act on gun violence.

findings.passage: I have, and will continue to be an ally of law-abiding gun owners. However, I support additional efforts at the national level to close existing loopholes that jeopardize public safety.
findings.note: His own op-ed, on why he wrote to the national groups.

findings.passage: Limiting access to assault weapons would seem appropriate to help prevent gunmen from inflicting the most deadly harm possible in a short period.
findings.note: Op-ed; argues for a national ban on assault weapons and cites the state's 1998 ban.

findings.passage: Why wouldn’t we want national action to prevent those who may cause harm from possessing a firearm?
findings.note: Op-ed, after describing the state red flag law (court-ordered licence suspension on petition of a relative or close contact); asks for national action of that kind.
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: The bottom line is that I will continue to advocate for policies that are proven to save lives, and that do not infringe on our Second Amendment rights.
I view this hearing as an opportunity for residents of the Commonwealth to provide comment on a very important and complex subject.
findings.note: His statement on a Senate informational hearing on bump-stock and trigger-crank language added to a spending bill; page shows Oct 20, 2017 (URL path says 10/12). He takes no side on the wording.

findings.passage: This legislation will help make sure we can protect our communities from gun violence without infringing the right to bear arms for law-abiding gun owners.
findings.note: His quoted comment in his office's release on the final 2024 firearm bill (ghost guns, red flag law, assault-style definition, carry limits).
